resources.string: Private voice input for your own Starling server
Use the server root, for example https://host:8181. You can also enter a matching route directly: /inference or /transcribe for Starling, or /v1/audio/transcriptions for OpenAI.
Allow HTTP for a trusted private LAN
Only localhost, private IPv4 or IPv6, link-local, or .local hosts are accepted. HTTPS remains the default.

Enable the keyboard in Android Settings, then choose it from the keyboard switcher.

Keyboards that use Android speech recognition (such as HeliBoard) show their own microphone button; pick Starling Voice Recognition under Voice input to dictate with Starling, on your server or on this device. Closed keyboards like Gboard keep their own engine.
